scenarios.steps: Run role preparation, binding, consolidation, final verification, and closeout.
scenarios.outcome: Required artifacts are named conceptually, but the public allowlist still does not provide the concrete preparation/consolidation/readiness commands or artifact locations.
The issue-owning orchestrator owns assumption review/model-floor escalation, and the escalation event plus suspended/resume state are specified sufficiently.

findings.summary: The readiness report is required to have a schema, location, generation command, and condition codes, but none of those concrete values are present in the public artifacts.
The document requires public documentation to name unsupported-capability recording and external-evidence binding commands/artifacts, but the allowlisted public docs do not name those procedures.

residualRisks: Maintainers may agree that the protocol is implemented while agents still cannot discover the exact commands and artifact paths from the public workflow.
